patch_description:
Replace the current-GPU-pressure greedy rule with a minimax rule that evaluates each model's resulting KVPR after placement, including the maximum KVPR of every GPU. This directly optimizes the stated objective instead of choosing a GPU based only on its pre-placement pressure.

After constructing a feasible initial placement, apply bounded local search using model relocations and swaps. Each change is accepted only when it strictly lowers the global maximum KVPR while preserving GPU memory constraints. Swaps are important because a beneficial relocation can require exchanging model memory capacity between two GPUs first.
